Privacy Policy

TikCam — AI Filter Camera

Overview

Your privacy is important to us. TikCam is designed to put you in control of your photos and data. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your choices.

In short: TikCam processes photos on your device. We do not upload, store, or sell your photos.

Information We Collect

Photos and Camera Data

TikCam uses your device's camera to capture photos and applies filters and AI-powered effects. All photo processing — including scene detection, filter application, and adjustments — happens directly on your device. We do not upload your photos or camera data to any server.

App Analytics

We may collect anonymous usage statistics to help improve the app, such as:

  • App launch frequency and session duration
  • Feature usage patterns (e.g., which filters are most popular)
  • Crash reports and performance data

This data is aggregated and cannot be used to identify you personally. No photos or personal content are included.

Information You Provide

If you contact us for support or feedback, we may collect your email address and any information you choose to share, solely for the purpose of responding to your inquiry.

How We Use Information

  • To provide and improve the TikCam app and its features
  • To fix bugs, optimize performance, and ensure stability
  • To respond to your support requests and feedback
  • To comply with legal obligations

Data Storage

Photos you save with TikCam are stored in your device's photo library. The app may also temporarily store photos on your device for editing purposes. You can delete these at any time through your device's settings.

Third-Party Services

TikCam may use third-party services for analytics, crash reporting, or app distribution (e.g., Apple's App Store, TestFlight). These services have their own privacy policies and may collect information as described therein. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.

Children's Privacy

TikCam does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us and we will promptly delete it.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you
  • Request correction or deletion of your personal information
  • Opt out of analytics data collection (through your device settings)
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent

Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy within the app or on our website. Your continued use of TikCam after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us:

Email: support@tikcam.app
